text:
anya: Idea: 'Benchmark Blitz' microwebinar series + microcopy launch posts + 100-credit immediate grant. Aim: test whether a small, focused benchmark + runnable prompt increases first-generate within 24h vs generic webinar.

sam: Nice. Primary metric = % signups with first_generate within 24h. Secondary = credit redemption and day7 retention.

kim: Ops Q: how do registrants get credits? auto-issue via promo API or manual?

olivia: Auto-issue via /v1/internal/promos/issue is fine. We'll tag promo_source=benchmark-blitz and set exclude_domains for enterprise. Need promo id and email copy by Wed EOD.

leo: Launch posts plan: 1) Benchmark highlight (latency/cost callout), 2) Quickstart snippet (runnable prompt), 3) Community invite (showcase examples). We'll run A/B for hero text.

anya: Experiment arms: baseline webinar + 100 credits, webinar + 100 credits + guided console tour, and a lightweight blog post + no-live webinar but same credits. Keep ~250 signups/arm.

sam: Tracking params: utm_campaign=benchmark-blitz, utm_source=social/newsletter, prompt_pack=bench-lite. Events: webinar_reg, promo_issued, first_generate.

kim: Also add a short nudging flow: email at 1h (run this prompt), 12h reminder with screenshot, 36h tip on cost controls. Measure email->generate conversion.

leo: I'll draft 3 concise social posts and a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the blog showing a 512-token example and cost delta vs quantized variant. Mockups: https://figma.com/s/benchmark-blitz-assets

olivia: Will wire webhook -> promo issue -> onboarding email with direct 'Run this prompt' CTA. Use a sample prompt in-email that can be copy-pasted.

anya: Keep external copy simple: 'Benchmark Blitz: run a real prompt now
100 credits + templates. Live microwebinar and on-demand.' We'll push to X and partners.

sam: Exclude corporate domains, and set conversion funnel in Amplitude. I'll build a small dashboard for same-day monitoring.

promo-bot: Promo created: id=PB-2025-BB-100, auto-issue enabled for campaign benchmark-blitz.

anya: Great. Quick sync 30m tomorrow to finalize copy and promo text. Want to launch next Tue. :rocket:
